verses.sahihInternational: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
verses.yusufAli: Respite will I grant unto them: for My scheme is strong (and unfailing).
verses.urdu: اور میں ان کو مہلت دیئے جاتا ہوں میری تدبیر (بڑی) مضبوط ہے

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.sahihInternational: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
verses.yusufAli: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
verses.urdu: خدا ہی تو رزق دینے والا زور آور اور مضبوط ہے

verses.sahihInternational: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
verses.yusufAli: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
verses.urdu: اور میں ان کو مہلت دیئے جاتا ہوں میری تدبیر قوی ہے
